name: PAVE Space
what: Orbital transfer vehicles (heavy kick stage) that move satellites from LEO to higher orbits in under a day.

membership.basis: Live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026) and Visionaries Club co-led the seed.
membership.quote: Visionaries Club and Creandum led the round

entry.quote: Swiss startup PAVE Space raised $40M in seed funding

funding_rounds.note: Foundation loan, not an equity round; amount not stated in the article.

valuation.quote: No valuation disclosed for the $40M seed (Payload, European Spaceflight, tech.eu checked).

graduation_surfaces: googlenews: "Pave Space" -> nothing after 2026-05-11 (PERL Trophy); last round is the Mar 2026 seed
googlenews: "Pave Space" Visionaries -> only the Mar 2026 seed coverage
notes: Seed is six months old (censored). HQ DISPUTE: Creandum's sibling row gives Munich, DE; every round article I re-fetched places the company in Switzerland (startupticker: 'Lausanne-based PAVE Space'; European Spaceflight: 'Switzerland's PAVE Space'; testing in Valais). pave.space is behind a Cloudflare challenge, so no imprint was readable. Founded 2024 by Julie Böhning and Jérémy Marciacq (Payload), out of the Gruyère Space Program.
